Count the distributions of 6 cards (2–7) among 3 players, each with at least one card.

Total surjections: 3^6 − 3·2^6 + 3 = 729 − 192 + 3 = 540.

The condition is "DBR has more than one card OR has an even-numbered spade." Its complement is: DBR has exactly one card, and that card is not even, so it is an odd card (3, 5, or 7).

Complement count: DBR has exactly 1 card, chosen from 3 odd cards. The other 5 cards go to RB and DB, each getting at least one: 2^5 − 2 = 30. So the complement is 3·30 = 90.

Answer: 540 − 90 = 450.

ANSWER: 450
